views.view_definition:
SELECT tenant_id,
    sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE (type = 'credit'::text)) AS total_credit,
    sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE (type = 'debit'::text)) AS total_debit,
    (sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE (type = 'credit'::text)) - sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE (type = 'debit'::text))) AS balance
   FROM financial_transactions
  WHERE (tenant_id IN ( SELECT user_tenant_ids() AS user_tenant_ids))
  GROUP BY tenant_id;

SELECT id,
    name,
    slug,
    category,
    short_description,
    description,
    card_image_url,
    hero_image_url,
    hero_title,
    hero_subtitle,
    icon,
    benefits,
    process_steps,
    cta_title,
    cta_description,
    cta_button_text,
    cta_button_url,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('url', ma.file_url, 'alt', ma.alt_text, 'sort_order', ma.sort_order) ORDER BY ma.is_primary DESC, ma.sort_order, ma.created_at) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM media_assets ma
          WHERE ((ma.tenant_id = s.tenant_id) AND (ma.entity_type = 'service'::text) AND (ma.entity_id = s.id))), '[]'::jsonb) AS gallery,
    status,
    published_at,
    display_order,
    seo_title,
    seo_description,
    seo_keywords
   FROM services s
  WHERE ((status = 'published'::text) AND (tenant_id = ( SELECT tenants.id
           FROM tenants
          WHERE (tenants.slug = 'js-empregos'::text)
         LIMIT 1)));

SELECT c.id AS company_id,
    c.name AS company_name,
    c.legal_name,
    c.trading_name,
    COALESCE(( SELECT ma.file_url
           FROM media_assets ma
          WHERE ((ma.tenant_id = c.tenant_id) AND (ma.entity_type = 'company'::text) AND (ma.entity_id = c.id) AND ((ma.is_primary = true) OR (ma.alt_text ~~* '%logo%'::text)))
          ORDER BY ma.is_primary DESC, ma.sort_order, ma.created_at
         LIMIT 1), c.logo_url) AS logo_url,
    COALESCE(( SELECT ma.file_url
           FROM media_assets ma
          WHERE ((ma.tenant_id = c.tenant_id) AND (ma.entity_type = 'company'::text) AND (ma.entity_id = c.id) AND ((ma.alt_text ~~* '%hero%'::text) OR (ma.title ~~* '%hero%'::text)))
          ORDER BY ma.sort_order, ma.created_at
         LIMIT 1), (cr.metadata ->> 'hero_image_url'::text), NULL::text) AS image_url,
    COALESCE((cr.metadata ->> 'description'::text), c.description) AS description,
    c.website,
    c.industry,
    c.size AS company_size,
    c.status AS company_status,
    cr.id AS relationship_id,
    cr.status AS relationship_status,
    crt.code AS relationship_type,
    crt.name AS relationship_type_name,
    cr.metadata AS relationship_metadata,
    cr.started_at AS relationship_started_at,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(lower(csl.platform), csl.url) AS jsonb_object_agg
           FROM company_social_links csl
          WHERE ((csl.tenant_id = cr.tenant_id) AND (csl.company_id = c.id) AND (csl.is_active = true))), '{}'::jsonb) AS socials
   FROM ((companies c
     JOIN company_relationships cr ON ((cr.company_id = c.id)))
     JOIN company_relationship_types crt ON ((crt.code = cr.relationship_type)))
  WHERE ((c.status = 'active'::text) AND (cr.status = 'active'::text) AND (COALESCE((c.metadata ->> 'is_test'::text), 'false'::text) <> 'true'::text));

SELECT tenant_id,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'open'::text)) AS open_demands,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'closed'::text)) AS closed_demands,
    count(*) AS total_demands
   FROM recruitment_demands
  WHERE (tenant_id IN ( SELECT user_tenant_ids() AS user_tenant_ids))
  GROUP BY tenant_id;

SELECT j.id AS job_id,
    j.title,
    j.slug,
    j.status,
    j.description,
    j.responsibilities,
    j.requirements,
    j.benefits,
    COALESCE(j.contract_type, j.employment_type, 'clt'::text) AS contract_type,
    j.work_mode,
        CASE
            WHEN ((j.city IS NOT NULL) AND (j.state IS NOT NULL)) THEN TRIM(BOTH ' '::text FROM ((j.city || ', '::text) || j.state))
            WHEN (j.city IS NOT NULL) THEN j.city
            WHEN (j.location IS NOT NULL) THEN j.location
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS location,
    j.location AS location_raw,
    j.city,
    j.state,
        CASE
            WHEN ((j.salary IS NOT NULL) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM j.salary)) > 0)) THEN j.salary
            WHEN ((j.salary_min IS NOT NULL) AND (j.salary_max IS NOT NULL)) THEN ((('R$ '::text || to_char(j.salary_min, 'FM999G999G990D00'::text)) || ' â€“ R$ '::text) || to_char(j.salary_max, 'FM999G999G990D00'::text))
            WHEN (j.salary_min IS NOT NULL) THEN ('R$ '::text || to_char(j.salary_min, 'FM999G999G990D00'::text))
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS salary_text,
    j.salary_min,
    j.salary_max,
    j.salary_type,
    c.id AS company_id,
    c.name AS company_name,
    COALESCE(( SELECT ma.file_url
           FROM media_assets ma
          WHERE ((ma.tenant_id = j.tenant_id) AND (ma.entity_type = 'company'::text) AND (ma.entity_id = c.id) AND ((ma.is_primary = true) OR (ma.alt_text ~~* '%logo%'::text)))
          ORDER BY ma.is_primary DESC, ma.sort_order, ma.created_at
         LIMIT 1), c.logo_url) AS company_logo_url,
    j.seniority,
    j.work_hours,
    (j.metadata ->> 'area'::text) AS area,
    (j.metadata ->> 'work_schedule'::text) AS work_schedule,
    j.published_at,
    j.expires_at,
    j.metadata,
    j.views_count,
    j.applications_count,
    j.tenant_id
   FROM (jobs j
     LEFT JOIN companies c ON ((c.id = j.company_id)))
  WHERE (j.status = 'published'::text);
